name: OpenVibe.Tips
notes: Creator support (roadmap Wave 9): tip interactions whose payment state mirrors OpenVibe.Billing (keyed by Billing transaction id) and whose delivery state is Tips' own; goals derived from settled interactions; paid messages, TTS and media requests created on settlement; scoped revocable overlay tokens with SSE overlays; simulation mode. Tips never moves money (ADR-012). Alpha: the placeholder on OpenVibe.Sites stays until the launch rule in README.md holds. Proposed manifest; replaces the placeholder in manifests/services/tips.json.
